\[
\tan\frac{5\pi}{12}=\tan\left(\frac{\pi}{6}+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)
=\frac{\frac1{\sqrt3}+1}{1-\frac1{\sqrt3}}=2+\sqrt3.
\]

Let \(t=\tan A\). Dividing numerator and denominator by \(\cos A\):

\[
\frac{\sqrt3+t}{\sqrt3 t-1}=2+\sqrt3.
\]

Solving:

\[
\sqrt3+t=(2+\sqrt3)(\sqrt3 t-1)
\]

\[
\sqrt3+t=(2\sqrt3+3)t-2-\sqrt3
\]

\[
(2\sqrt3+2)t=2+2\sqrt3
\]

\[
t=1.
\]

\[
\boxed{1}
\]
